textual.observation: A capture page is described as promoting an automated trading system to generate more bitcoin while asking viewers to submit their name, email and mobile phone and click to watch videos.

evidence.quote: finally revealed new automated force trading system that anyone can use to generate more bitcoin
when people put in their information their name email and mobile phone and click the watch videos

textual.context: Promotional demonstration of a funnel and capture page; ASR_0002 refers to "my main capture page".
textual.potential_relevance: A promised cryptocurrency return is directly linked to submitting contact information and clicking through to video content, creating a reward-and-request relationship for later review.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish actual returns, required payment for this specific step, data handling, or whether anyone submitted information; the ASR wording may contain recognition errors.

textual.observation: The speaker states that starting on the platform requires $100 and invites viewers to join his team and get started alongside a claim about generating more bitcoin.

evidence.quote: amount to start is one hundred dollars in the platform
click the tour link check it out join my team and get started

textual.context: Promotional recruitment framing; ASR_0003 calls it "my opportunity".
textual.potential_relevance: A stated upfront minimum is connected to joining a team and a cryptocurrency-generation claim, linking a start-up payment action with a promised return.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish that payment was made, who receives it, the terms of any return, or whether the $100 is mandatory for every viewer.

textual.observation: The speaker presents himself as part of a Mirror Trading International team and directs viewers to a MyBullRun.com funnel and tour page to join that team.

evidence.quote: if you are part of my Mirror Trading International team
We have a funnel by the name of MyBullRun.com that you can use.
click the tour link check it out join my team and get started

textual.context: The affiliation and destination are presented in a promotional team-building context; ASR_0003 says "this is just an extended opportunity that help our team grow".
textual.potential_relevance: A claimed team affiliation is tied to a directed external funnel or tour and an invitation to join, making the identity-and-destination relationship relevant for later assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not verify the speaker's affiliation, ownership or operation of MyBullRun.com, or what viewers would receive after clicking.

visual.observation: A MyBullRun-branded page promotes participation in automated forex trading with Bitcoin as a “completely passive way” and displays a “Get Started Now” button. Related sampled screens on the same site show a “Minimum Amount” of 100 and “Secure Wallets” value of 4250.
visual.context: Visible promotional content for a financial trading service; the sampled screens do not show a completed payment, transfer, account outcome, or explicit return guarantee.
visual.potential_relevance: The page links a low-effort/passive financial participation claim and a start action with visible monetary figures and a minimum amount, which may merit review of what payment or financial outcome is being presented.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish the currency, whether the figures are deposits, balances, or examples, any promised profit or timeframe, who receives funds, or whether the pages represent a real transaction.

textual_context_notes.observation: The speaker frames the material as a team-growth opportunity and a back-office walkthrough.

evidence.quote: I'm going to take you in the back office and show you what's going on.
this is just an extended opportunity that help our team grow

textual_context_notes.observation: The funnel is also described as a paid marketing service with automated follow-up tools and a monthly text-message allowance.

evidence.quote: It's $30 a month and you get everything complete with auto responder.
Every month you get 250 uh text messages

visual_context_notes.observation: The sampled sequence also shows a logged-in back-office interface with training, marketing pages, lead capture, text-message campaign, and social-sharing controls for the MyBullRun site.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the speaker promotes a team opportunity for automated, passive forex trading involving Bitcoin and directs viewers to “Get Started Now.” The funnel says the trading page can generate more Bitcoin, requests contact details to view videos, and states that starting costs $100, framing the material as a financial participation solicitation. the available video evidence does not establish actual returns, payment completion, or resulting loss.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The promoted automated trading system is linked to generating more Bitcoin, a passive forex-trading participation page with a start control, and the speaker's stated platform starting amount. No completed funding or return is shown.

evidence.quote: We have a funnel by the name of MyBullRun.com that you can use.

evidence.observation: The speaker describes a $30 monthly charge for the funnel and its autoresponder, distinct from the platform starting amount.
